meta.purpose: Curriculum backbone + scene-engine authoring spec for the AP Tutor (Avalonia/.NET 8, SkiaSharp scene engine, Neural TTS). Ports the GeoTutor DAG model.

schema.id: u<unit>.<topic> (stable key used by DAG edges, mastery tracker, and scene bindings)
schema.prereqs: array of node ids that must be mastered first
schema.viz: what the SkiaSharp scene engine renders for this node (the CS-specific innovation over GeoTutor's geometry primitives)

scenePrimitives.memCell: labeled box holding a primitive value (name : type = value); flashes on write
scenePrimitives.refArrow: arrow from a stack variable/box into a heap object box (reference vs. value teaching)
scenePrimitives.heapObject: rounded box with field memCells inside; the target of refArrows
scenePrimitives.indexedStrip: horizontal cells with index labels — Array / ArrayList / String backing
scenePrimitives.grid2d: row/col indexed matrix of cells — 2D array traversal
scenePrimitives.stackFrame: labeled frame with local memCells; frames stack downward for calls
scenePrimitives.callTree: node-per-invocation recursion tree, expands as calls are made, collapses on return with return value badge
scenePrimitives.lineHighlight: current-execution-line marker synced to the tracer step
scenePrimitives.exprBubble: sub-expression evaluation shown inline, collapsing left-to-right / precedence order
scenePrimitives.boolTruthGlow: true/false coloring on boolean sub-expressions for short-circuit teaching
